column1: # OWASP ZAP rule configuration for the API scan in CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job "dast").
# Format: <rule id> TAB <IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL> TAB <reason>. Rules not listed keep the default
# level, WARN, and any WARN fails the job. Every rule set to INFO says why its alerts are expected.

column3: 4xx answers are the expected result of the scan: a customer token calling staff routes (403), malformed and attack inputs (422), unknown resources (404).
Identifies the login endpoint; informational by design, sign-in is rate limited and audited.
Matches the parameter name actor_user_id (a UUID filter on the admin audit log), not sensitive data; credentials never travel in URLs.
Every API response is Cache-Control: no-store on purpose (personal data must not be cached).
